theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ted_pl_proj_limit_rank
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (w : Fin P → Euclid P), (∀ j, Module.finrank ℝ (S j) = n) → (∀ i : Fin P, Tendsto (fun j => (S j).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 (w i))) → ∃ S' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ S' = n ∧ ∀ i : Fin P, S'.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = w i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
